items.title: File Widerspruch against GdB decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats Widerspruch erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Versorgungsamt Beispielfeld, Am Versorgungsamt 1, 49074 Musterosna.
items.computation: Letter dated and presumably posted 27.05.2026 (Wednesday); no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the letter date is the posting date. The Versorgungsamt deciding under SGB IX/SGB X is a social-law body, so § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: the decision counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, and (unlike for tax offices under § 108 Abs. 3 AO) this delivery day is NOT shifted even if it falls on a weekend or holiday. 27.05.2026 + 4 days = 31.05.2026 (Sunday) = date of Bekanntgabe. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X with §§ 187, 188 BGB) runs from this event date; under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the event day. 31 June does not exist, so per the end-of-month rule the period ends on the last day of June, i.e. 30.06.2026 (Tuesday). This is neither a weekend day nor a public holiday in NRW, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
